tasks.label: debug: kill backend port 8000
args: pids=$(lsof -tiTCP:8000 -sTCP:LISTEN || true); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then kill -9 $pids; echo "Stopped port 8000 listeners: $pids"; else echo "Port 8000 is free"; fi

args: pids=$(lsof -tiTCP:5173 -sTCP:LISTEN || true); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then kill -9 $pids; echo "Stopped port 5173 listeners: $pids"; else echo "Port 5173 is free"; fi
